title: equisetum multiforme var. variegatum
intro: Equisetum multiforme var. variegatum, commonly known as the variegated horsetail, is a type of perennial plant belonging to the Equisetaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include promoting urinary tract health and alleviating symptoms of kidney stones, kidney infections, and urinary tract infections due to its diuretic and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Equisetum multiforme var. variegatum include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and diuretic effects, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, although further research is needed to fully understand its bioactive properties.
